notes.title: Patch 0.3.5.0 Live for Testing #2
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44732938/f87718632d4ed2a68eb91485f5b7a8464ad66471.jpg"]

Hey, GZW Community,

Thanks everyone for testing Patch 0.3.5.0 and providing us with your valuable feedback. We’ve updated the build on the public-test branch, and the Patch is now live again for continued testing.

This patch brings significant changes to the game, along with fixes for numerous community-reported issues. 


Main improvements to test:
Performance & Client Crashes after the UE 5.5 upgrade

Improved AI Aiming

Weapon Sway Tweaks

You can find the complete CHANGELOG below. (Please note: some details may still change before the patch goes live.)

Public Testing Changelog \[Not Final]

Key Enhancements and Changes
Focus on optimizing the movement animations in the 1st person perspective in various ways:

Reduced several animations affecting the 1st person perspective, reducing excessive character movement and animation blending. For example, the top half of the character’s body was decoupled from the 1st perspective animations, and the breath animation was disabled in the 1st person perspective.

The weapon sway was adjusted, making it more responsive when the player moves

Pistol recoil has been tweaked to make it more realistic

New and improved death sequence from the 1st person perspective. The player’s vision turns to the approximate direction from which the player was shot.

AI aiming rebalancing: The new system simulates human-like aiming behavior that varies based on AI difficulty level, combat situation, injuries, suppression, weather conditions, distance to the target, and weapon type.

Updated Unreal Engine to version 5.5

Most important changes and fixes reported by and requested by the community
Fixed an issue where lasers were not working correctly in specific locations, such as YBL-1 and parts of Midnight Sapphire

Fixed a bug that caused the key drop frequency in Fort Narith to be incorrectly low

Fixed the gunshot sounds where the sonic crack can be heard before the gunshot

Fixed missing Twitch drops rewards for players who were unable to claim them until now

Fixed an issue causing very dark nights with the global illumination set to medium or higher

Fixed an issue where players would get stuck under the ground or would fall through the map after getting revived

Fixed the disabled FSR frame generation on RX580 graphics cards

Gameplay
Fixed an issue where players always died if they got into a coma while in a helicopter

Fixed an issue where using the splint didn't prioritize the most damaged bone

Adjusted the extraction range for the squad strike Fragile Goods from 2,5m to 25m to allow for easier completion of the task

Fixed a rare issue where blood stops regenerating after healing all wounds

Fixed an issue where the player's weapon can become invisible after examining another player with a grenade in hand

Fixed the RIS II 12 Handguard compatibility with shorter barrels

Added the missing FDE AK Handguard to the military firearms box loot table

Added the missing HP Bunker key to the Hunter's Paradise Boss loot table

World
Adjusted the ground assets in the Spielberk COP to prevent climbing on top of the roof

Fixed the area on top of the Crusader COP, which was previously not recognized as a part of the COP area

Fixed a missing collision on a wall near the Tiger Bay Central South East entrance

Fixed an issue where the clouds were sometimes moving too fast

Fixed the incorrect collision around fountains in the Midnight Sapphire that caused grenades to bounce off

Fixed several locations where players could get stuck: 

Tiger Bay Wrecking Yard at 195, 130

Fanny Paradise - between a house and some pallets at 189, 121

In rocks near Sabai Lake Restaurant at 204, 152

In rocks near Inthavong Farm at 159, 133

Near Sawmill, between logs and a container at 138, 143

Outside of the Nomad COP at 189, 157

Disabled lights that were unintentionally on during the daytime

Fixed an obsolete interaction option on a light switch in YBL-1

UI
Fixed an incorrect "joined squad" notification when a player was promoted to the squad leader

Fixed an issue where a messenger channel would get stuck in the pinned section after unpinning

Fixed an issue where the messenger window would fail to display when sending a message through the player interaction panel

Removed the option to invite to a squad from offline friends in the friend list

Faction kill is now pre-selected as the reason in the reporting window when reporting a player for a faction kill

Fixed the incorrect text wrapping in the feedback form text window

Fixed the incorrect DLC message wrapping in Czech

Fixed the conflict zone details in the Spanish localization

Fixed the conflict zone detail text not updating when changing the game language

Fixed the incorrect size of the maintenance notification widget in the main menu

Unified the position of the maintenance window on various resolutions/screen sizes

Fixed an issue where the character level was displayed as zero instead of 1 after a wipe

Fixed an empty icon in the hair section of the character creation screen

Fixed an issue causing the weather forecast in the main menu to be out of sync with the in-game one

Custom Servers
Fixed an issue where the player count was not greyed out when a custom server was running

Fixed wrong wording on the player list on custom servers

Implemented support for gamepad control for the free cam on custom servers

Fixed an issue where players who join a custom server for the first time have "Nickname" displayed instead of their username

Fixed an issue where the player's rank was not set correctly on custom servers despite using the Everything Unlocked preset

Technical and performance fixes
Various performance, RAM, and VRAM optimizations

Numerous crash fixes

Improved the suggested default settings based on the player’s hardware

Fixed an issue where closing the game by pressing ALT+F4 might lead to the game freezing

Fixed an issue that caused the Load Friends Failed error if a player accumulated over 100 friends

Fixed an issue where Steam friends data was not loaded after 60 minutes in the main menu

Fixed an issue where players were unable to join the server as a squad leader under specific circumstances

Technical Updates
Updated Oodle to 2.9.14 to workaround crashes related to specific Intel CPUs

Updated DLSS to 8.1.0

Updated Epic Online Services SDK to version 1.17.1.3

Compared to Patch 0.3.5.0 Testing #1, we improved the analytics data we’re gathering on performance and crashes and applied a few additional fixes. 


Additional Changelog compared to Patch 0.3.5.0 Testing #1:
\[Fixed] Incomplete weapon shadow on the ground

\[Fixed] Black artifacts sometimes appearing when using NVGs with the XeSS upscaling method

\[Fixed] Choppy sprinting animation transition when repeatedly pressing the Shift key

\[Fixed] Splints not healing damaged bones under certain circumstances

\[Fixed] Noticeable bump after stopping in the dynamic crouch animation

\[Fixed] Weapon becoming invisible in 1PV after being revived from a coma while holding a grenade

 We will continue working on fixes based on your feedback.


Instructions & Feedback Form
We have a new feedback form. Please read the instructions carefully and complete the form once you finish your playtest: https://forms.gle/PXfF32Xpak6xHrg56

 
Available servers:
EU West

US East

US West
Modes:
Warfare (PvEvP)

Joint Ops (PvE)



In this public test, you will have adjusted progression, but your live progression will not be affected. 

How to join?[olist]
 Go offline and online in Steam (via the Steam tab in the upper left corner). 

 Right-click on Gray Zone Warfare and select "Properties." 

 In the "Betas" tab, click on "none" ("Beta Participation" section) and select "public-experimental." server 

 Update the game. 
[/olist]
Feel free to discuss in the public-test-chat channel on our Discord. Playtest will last for a few days. 



Thank you for your continued feedback and bug reports, they’re vital to making Gray Zone Warfare better with every update. 

Every Move Matters,
MADFINGER Games Team

notes.title: Patch 0.3.4.0 Now Live - Changelog
notes.content:
Hey, GZW Community,



Patch 0.3.4.0 is now live on the public branch. Download the update and dive in.



This patch addresses numerous community-reported issues, ranging from key respawn rates in Fort Narith, AI vision tweaks, a fix to the Vulture's location, and many other improvements. 



Thanks to everyone who joined the Experimental Testing and contributed with their feedback. We're already working on the next patches, so stay tuned.


Changelog

Community-requested changes and adjustments
Improved clarity of the notification message when logging out from the server outside of the friendly area

Boosted the drop rate of keys in Fort Narith

Adjusted the weather schedule to provide a more varied overall weather profile

Removed collisions on wooden logs placed on the ground

 
World
Added more vegetation to the area around the India 2 landing zone

Fixed several locations where players could get stuck in the environment:

Near Spielberk COP

Hill next to the stairs in Sunset Chalet

Rocks near the UNLRA refugee camp

Rocks near the Fishing hut

Rocks near India 3

Next to a concrete fence in Ban Phouphienge

Bush in the starter towns
Gameplay
Fixed an issue where task items randomly disappeared when handing over task items in specific tasks

Fixed an issue that caused safes to reset without also resetting the loot inside of them

Fixed an issue that might cause the canting to get stuck if you spam the button

Fixed an issue where more than one Squad strike mission was present in the same area

Fixed an issue where players were able to capture a COP by interacting with the flag pole

Fixed an issue where repair kit charges were not consumed under specific circumstances

Fixed an issue where Vulture's location was not synced correctly between all servers

Fixed the light direction of AI flashlights to better reflect where they are looking

Adjusted AI's vision to better address the environment and weather conditions

Adjusted the way sliding from a steep hill is detected, which should result in a decrease in accidental and unrealistic deaths

 
UI
Fixed a rare issue where the player locker was unavailable for some players under specific circumstances

Fixed an issue where adding tracking tags to mortar shells resulted in an error and consumed the tag

Fixed an issue that caused the maintenance notification to disappear after opening the game menu

Improved the visibility of the server maintenance notification when in-game

Fixed missing ban description on the ban notification screen

 
Technical & rendering
Various client crashes and a rare server crash were fixed

Fixed a rare issue where the game cannot be started due to a 'Steam not Running' error if the path to the 'Documents' folder is invalid

Fixed an issue that caused players to be unable to connect to a regular server after crashing on a custom server under specific circumstances

Implemented a benchmark to adjust the optimal graphical settings for given PC specs when running the game for the first time

Adjusted the default upscaler method to reflect the player's graphics card better

Disabled NVidia Reflex when using FSR frame generation to prevent possible crashes

Disabled DLSS Frame generation when using XeSS or FSR upscalers

Implemented various RAM optimizations in the Skalla engine



If you encounter any further issues, please report them to our Customer Care. Your bug reports and feedback are invaluable in helping us improve Gray Zone Warfare: https://support.madfingergames.com/hc/en-us/requests/new



We're committed to improving Gray Zone Warfare with every step of development and will continue to share updates along the way.



Thanks for being part of the Early Access journey.



Every Move Matters,

MADFINGER Games Team

notes.title: Patch 0.3.3.0 Now Live - Changelog
notes.content:
Hey, GZW Community,



Patch 0.3.3.0 is now live on the public branch. Download the update and dive in.



This patch addresses numerous community-reported issues across gameplay, AI respawns, animations, rendering, and UI, and includes several technical fixes. You’ll find the changelog below.



Thanks to everyone who joined the Experimental Testing. Your feedback showed us the Patch is ready for a public release. We're already working on the next patches and hotfixes, so stay tuned.


Changelog:

Gameplay changes
Coma duration has been increased to 5 minutes. This change aims to make it easier to drag your fallen mates to safety by giving you more time to secure your environment.

Tracking tags can no longer be attached to storage cases. Since they cannot be removed from the locker anyway, we prevented the possibility of wasting a tracker.

When running the game for the first time, the default mode is now set to Warfare.


Gameplay fixes
Fixed an issue that caused Vulture’s location to not sync properly on all servers

Fixed an issue causing the AI NPCs to spawn indefinitely at the gas station east of Fort Narith

Fixed an issue where AI NPCs at the Slang Radio Station were dropping the key to Inthavong Farm incorrectly

Fixed an issue where Vulture was only available to the faction that captured the COP last on PVE servers

Fixed a rare bug where players might become immune to damage from their faction under specific circumstances

Fixed an issue where the tracking notifications were triggered if a player consumed food previously tracked by another player

Fixed an issue that caused the auto-gating feature on NVGs to work inconsistently during specific hours of the day

Fixed an issue where hitting an enemy with a mortar blast created conflict zones

Fixed a rare issue where organs were damaged despite the fact that the player sustained only a bruise

Fixed an issue where sometimes a member of a full squad was unable to board a helicopter under specific circumstances

Fixed an issue where recent enemy shots could be heard again after respawning


Animations
Fixed the missing hand animation of putting on NVGs

Fixed a rare issue where player characters were rendered in a T-pose while in prone under specific circumstances

Fixed an issue where the character slid in both 1PV and 3PV after being revived from a coma under specific circumstances

Fixed a rare animation where hands and the bolt were not moving in sync during a cocking animation
Rendering and visual fixes
Fixed a graphical artifact showing oversized reticles outside of the weapon in 3PV

Fixed a rare issue where a player's weapon would disappear after reviving someone from a coma

Fixed an issue where clothes were sometimes not rendered on NPC corpses

Adjusted the brightness and clarity of holographic sights on various graphical presets

Vegetation density of small vegetation, such as grass blades, is reduced on low graphics settings


World
Fixed an issue causing the moon to look brighter and overlap clouds when aiming at it with a scope

Fixed a spot on the road between Fort Narith and Sawmill where players could clip through the terrain under specific circumstances

Adjusted the rotation speed of wind socks in Fort Narith


Technical fixes
Various minor RAM usage and server performance optimizations

Various crash fixes

Disabled creating files in the Skalla folder to prevent related issues

Optimized the audio compression quality to reduce RAM usage

Fixed an issue where the framerate was capped after turning on frame generation and V-sync repeatedly

Fixed an issue where players might get stuck on a loading screen at 72% when reconnecting after getting kicked for inactivity

Fixed an issue where players might get stuck on a loading screen after canceling the maintenance window by pressing the escape key

Fixed uninitialized mesh materials to prevent related crashes


UI
Fixed an issue where the character name displayed "Nickname" instead of "Operator" for players with Streamer mode enabled

Fixed the faction bonus window description to fit the text in all language variations

Fixed a missing error message when multiple players try to use the same consumable item in a container

Fixed an issue that caused the weather forecast in the main menu and in the game to be out of sync

Fixed a minor UI issue when switching the bottom categories in the locker

Fixed an issue where the Squad Strike Mission window would overlap the objectives under the briefing text

Moved the maintenance notification in the main menu to prevent overlap with other elements on the screen

Added the information that a player is connected to a custom server to their info panel in the friends list

Added a notification that some localization changes will take effect after restarting the client

Added the option to select between a localized compass and an English NATO compass

The dollar balance in the locker now displays only one decimal when a player has less than 10 dollars


Custom servers
Fixed an incorrect error message displayed when trying to join a full custom server

Fixed an issue where server owners were unable to shut down a running server that they started after wiping their character

Fixed an issue where the Operator tag fails to apply after leaving a custom server

Updated the custom server option for fully unlocked characters



If you encounter any further issues, please report them to our Customer Care. Your bug reports and feedback are invaluable in helping us improve Gray Zone Warfare:





https://support.madfingergames.com/hc/en-us/requests/new





We're committed to improving Gray Zone Warfare with every step of development and will continue to share updates along the way.



Thanks for being part of the Early Access journey.



Every Move Matters,

MADFINGER Games Team

notes.title: Patch 0.3.2.0 Now Live - Changelog
notes.content:
Hey, GZW Community,



Patch 0.3.2.0 is now live on the public branch. Download the update and dive in.



This Patch includes many improvements and fixes based on your feedback. Notable changes include the addition of illumination for selected reticles, the first iteration of contrast abuse countermeasures, further VRAM optimizations, vendor stock tweaks, and a fix for armor losing protection when equipping rigs.



We're genuinely grateful for your feedback from the Experimental Testing, which has confirmed that the fixes are working as intended. We are working on future patches and hotfixes as we speak, so stay tuned, and thank you for your support.


Changelog:

Notable Fixes/Improvements
The minimum contrast value has been adjusted to prevent exploits during nighttime gameplay

Equipping rigs no longer causes the vest armor to lose its protection value

Reduced restrictions on selected items in vendors' stocks:

Handshake: APVS7 (unlimited), APVS14, APVS31 (increased stock)

Vulture: Level 3 - Modded SVD (added)

Gunny: Level 3 - HPBT ammunition (unlimited)

Banshee: Level 1 - Whisper Blackout Ammo (unlimited), Blackout FMJ Ammo (stocked), 4.6x30 subsonic (unlimited), 4.6x30 FMJ (stocked); Level 2 - Blackout FMJ (unlimited); Level 3 - 4.6x30 Action (unlimited)

Added an option to enable/disable illumination on selected scopes with illuminated reticles:

Pilad Р2.5х24L Brevis Assault Scope

ACOG TA01NSN 4x32 Assault Scope

SpecterDR 1-4x Assault Scope

Vudu 1-6x24 FFP Rifle Scope

RAZOR 1-6x Rifle Scope

PSO-1 4x24, NPZ PSO 3-9x24

Viper PST Gen II 5-25x50 Rifle Scope

The effect of fog and raindrops on NVGs, scopes, and collimators was reduced to increase visibility

Conflict Zone diameter increased to 300 m

Quick Access Menu now correctly displays all available tactical devices

Vomiting no longer interrupts healing animations

Several types of client crashes

A minor VRAM usage optimization was implemented


AI
Fixed an issue where AI NPCs could occasionally overlap or walk on top of each other

AI NPCs no longer clip through ground or objects

Allied AI NPCs no longer appear in the air after the player captures a Combat Outpost

AI NPCs can no longer pass through a locked door in Ban Khampet

Fixed an issue causing fatal wounds of AI NPCs not to display correctly on the Looting Screen under certain circumstances

AI NPCs in the villas area of Midnight Sapphire no longer spawn equipped with SVDs

AI NPC spawn rates were slightly increased at smaller locations

AI NPCs no longer spawn in the locked room at Yacht Club in Tiger Bay


UI
Players no longer get "Task Completed" notification every time they log in

Fixed an issue where the mouse pointer displayed a rectangular shadow when hovering over certain Main Menu elements

XP bar now correctly fills only by the amount of XP awarded from completing a task, preventing overflow

Information about multiple wounds in the same location now displays correctly in the Health Screen

Number of charges on provisions and medical items now updates correctly in loot boxes when multiple players interact with them simultaneously

The prompt now displays the correct text when safely ending deployment in Combat Outposts

Hovering over the "Report" button on the death screen no longer displays an unintended square

Report button no longer greys out after a comment is entered, and the Report window is canceled

A dedicated icon for Tracking Tag in the context menu has been added

Fixed a typo in the Basic Equipment Repair Kit description

Small Suture Kit no longer appears overly zoomed in upon opening

Dragging a 3D object in the inventory no longer results in item names being displayed as "Text Block"

Scorpion Vz.61 can now be placed inside the buried containers

Players can now properly interact with objects while holding a grenade

Mortar strike line thickness now visually represents their levels

Death screen now displays correct information for deaths caused by radiation, falls, and explosions

Relocated the Maintenance timer to prevent obstruction of other Main Menu elements

Wiping a player's character now correctly removes vendor messages


Localization
Unsupported languages no longer appear as an option in the in-game language settings

Fixed a typo in the Czech localization of the Character Customization screen

The "End deployment outside of FOB" prompt is now localized for all supported languages

On/Off slider options in the "Game" tab of in-game settings are now localized

The word 'Crash' in the Feedback form is now localized properly

Custom server hints are now localized for all supported languages

The 'Faction signup bonus' text was adjusted in PT-BR

The format for prices over 1,000 USD in the vendor screen for Spanish localization


Graphics
The environment no longer disappears and re-renders after alt-tabbing when using DLSS or XeSS

Gray hair on low graphic presets no longer appears excessively shiny in the 3D character preview

Scoping in with a PSO while PVS-14 is active no longer produces a blurry background

Moon now displays proper textures in cloudy weather on low graphic settings

Raindrops no longer appear black on the night vision device lenses

Razor 1-6x red dot appears the same across all graphic settings

AI NPCs' flashlights are no longer passing through walls or objects

Flashlight illumination no longer disappears in third-person view when observing player movement

All weather presets now have correct lighting during nighttime

Overall ambient no longer appears too dark when Global Illumination is set to low

Adjusted night brightness on low graphic presets (in non-moonlit conditions)


Animations
Surkit animations were refined to have uniform length, and camera shake was reduced

AI ragdoll animations now start from the correct initial pose

Skorpion Vz. 61 magazine no longer displays incorrectly during weapon check or magazine check animations

The SKS magazine no longer clips through the weapon during the reload animation while crouching

The slide is now correctly pushed by the player's character during reload animations for the Glock 17 and Glock 17 Olive when in prone

Player character no longer twitches when switching between weapons in third-person and first-person view

Prone and sprint animations and their transitions now display correctly

Crouched movement initiation with rifles and pistols was tweaked to prevent camera and weapon glitching during micro-movements

Holding ADS no longer prevents interaction with doors


World
Supply Crates for use by community Game Masters during events have been added, allowing them to store and distribute loot

Many locations where player could get stuck have been fixed:

Between a box and wall in Pershing

Northwest of Gladius Combat Outpost

At three places near Spielberk Combat Outpost

Between rocks in the Refugee Camp

Between rocks near Tiger Bay Viewpoint

Between rocks near Echo 3 Landing Zone

In the waterfalls near Hunter's Paradise

On a bed in Kiu Vongsa Criminal Hideout

At two places near Siang Radio Station

At Trade Depot in Tiger Bay

On a table in Ban Pa

Near Resort Golf Course

Between rocks near Sawmill

Between rocks near Fanny Paradise

Near India 3 LZ

On a fence at Kiu Vongsa

On a chair in Town Hall"

Multiple floating and clipping objects have been fixed:

Various objects at Sunset Chalet

Various loot in Tiger Bay

A tree at the Atlas Combat Outpost

Car Engine in Blue Lagoon

Loot near the Military Base Control Tower in Fort Narith

Loot clipping through the barrel in Khonwan Village

Loot in the bathroom at Whitewater Villas (Midnight Sapphire)

Loot in Phousai Village

Loot in Chon Village

Loot near Nam Thaven

Loot in the Tiger Bay Mall

Loot in Xai Farms

Fixed incorrectly assigned material of:

A table in Fort Narith Headquarters

A Snack Kiosk

Fixed a hole in the terrain near Bearcat

Fixed the water texture incorrectly placed on the landscape near the November 2 Landing Zone

Grenades no longer bounce off an invisible collision at Hunter's Paradise Firing Lanes

Certain windows in the Terminal at Pha Lang Airfield and Midnight Sapphire are no longer bulletproof

Small Marketplace House Key now correctly spawns near Pha Lang Airfield

Improved key spawn for the Siang Radio Station Room

Helicopter can no longer fly through a tree on the way from the Landing Zone Kilo 1 to Mike 2

Missing street lamps are now properly placed in Tiger Bay and Military Base


Custom Servers
Players who are kicked from a custom server are not able to reconnect to the server

Custom server tooltips now display text correctly when hovered over

Custom Server management reliability was improved

Player no longer gets stuck in 'Starting server' state anymore after wiping and changing username

Option to enable/disable limited stock on custom servers

Combat outposts now correctly enter contested state on custom servers with disabled AI


Twitch Drops
Re-linking user's account through the Twitch platform now properly re-links it on the Twitch Drops campaign page

The Twitch Drops main menu button will now be hidden when no campaign is active

Undelivered Twitch Drops will now be processed more regularly, potentially decreasing the time taken to appear in the messenger


Strike Missions
Squad leaders now receive an error message when attempting to accept a Strike Mission while their squad member is dead

Task items connected to Strike Missions now properly disappear from the player's inventory after failing the tasks

Shimmer On The Surface RTT objectives are now completing in the correct order


Weapons and Ammunition
The appearance of the new AK Izhmash Bakelite 5.45 and 7.62 magazines now correctly reflects 100% durability

The crosshairs of ACOG and SpecterDR remain visible at all distances in third-person view

Fixed an issue where weapon part colors would shift based on viewing distance in the third-person view

Zeroing is now functional with default iron sights on M4 and AK weapons

Fixed the AKM Zhukov FDE Stock compatibility issue

M14x1to1228 adapter can no longer be obtained

Only one collimator can now be mounted on the Glock 17

Aimpoint T2 collimators now display the correct icon and description

Player is no longer able to use weapon parts that are being repaired.

Composition of M62 ammunition adjusted to reflect real-world behavior

Weapon collision boxes now update properly when the player switches weapons

Fixed an issue with the weapon remaining stuck in canted position after ending a session with canting enabled


Other fixes
Fixed an issue where the initial message from Handshake would appear twice after wiping a character

Vendor messages containing rewards are no longer duplicated

Fixed an issue affecting players with 50-series GPUs using DLSS FrameGen, where duplicated generated frames caused increasing input lag and choppiness

Items now stack up when picking them up from the ground

The Nuklear Energy Drink provision values now reflect the item size

Rain sounds now correctly play on the Vendor screen

An issue where the shooting sound effect would sometimes fail to play for each fired shot.

Civilian Medkits (HCKits) spawn rate was reduced

The objectives of the Snooper Task are now completing in the correct order

Miscellaneous items and keys are now properly taggable with Tracking Tags



If you encounter any further issues, please report them to our Customer Care. Your bug reports and feedback are invaluable in helping us improve Gray Zone Warfare:



https://support.madfingergames.com/hc/en-us/requests/new





We're dedicated to improving Gray Zone Warfare with every step of this ongoing development, and we'll keep sharing updates as we go.



Thanks for being part of the Early Access journey.



Every Move Matters,

MADFINGER Games Team

notes.content:
Hey, GZW Community,

Patch 0.3.1.0 is now live on the public branch. Download the update and dive in.

This patch includes over a hundred improvements and fixes based on the early feedback we have received. Notable changes include tweaks to the NVGs, the Operator VO volume, or VRAM leak reductions.

We’re truly grateful for your feedback from the Experimental Testing, which has confirmed that the fixes are working as intended. Of course, we’re not stopping here. We’ll be addressing additional issues in upcoming hotfixes and patches.

Changelog:
AI

 Fixed an issue where the AI navigation failed around specific doors in the starter towns' Town halls
 Fixed a rare issue where the AI NPCs might glitch through closed doors
 Fixed an issue where AI NPCs were twitching and sliding when walking over uneven terrain

User Interface

 Fixed an issue where mortar hits incorrectly spawned new Conflict Zones
 Fixed an issue where the death screen might display incorrect info under specific circumstances
 Fixed an issue where the weapon stats were not updated in real time when a player has the weapon detail window opened and gets shot
 Fixed an intermittent issue where the minimap stayed open after respawning
 Improved the messenger UI for better clarity
 Adjusted the scale of some items in the details window 
 Fixed the maintenance notification message that incorrectly stated that the client was incompatible
 Fixed the maintenance screen to be displayed to players in the game menu when the maintenance starts
 Fixed a rare issue where the night was extremely dark under specific circumstances
 Fixed excessive image noise when using NVGs with Global Illumination set to low
 Fixed the incorrect text on the .300 AAC Blackout ammunition
 Fixed the visibility of waypoints placed in a conflict zone

Weapons, gear & weapon parts

 Fixed the incorrect inventory size of the M9A1 9X19MM 30-Round Magazine
 Fixed an issue that prevented attaching tactical devices to the BM-1 AKM Accessory mount
 Weapon modifiers that have no impact on the weapon stats are now hidden
 Fixed the rear iron sight from clipping with NVGs
 Fixed an incorrect short name on the .300 blackout ammo
 Fixed missing water protection on the Exfil and LSHZ 1+ (multicam) helmets
 Fixed an issue where the iron sights were not updating properly when changing the iron sights' state
 Adjusted NVGs to have less visual noise and a brighter image; decreased the zoom level Scoping with NVGs will now force canting when selected scopes are attached to a rifle
 Fixed an issue where raindrops outside of the NVG view were also highlighted
 Fixed a missing string on the SVD Chassis MK1 handguard bottom rear keymod slot

Localization

 Fixed an issue where an incorrect language was displayed in the language selector under specific circumstances
 Fixed missing localization on the seasonal wipe screen
 Fixed missing localization of some parts of the custom server menu
 Fixed multiple minor localization issues
 Fixed multiple instances of missing localization in game settings
 Fixed the incorrect localization of specific server names for the Spanish language
 Fixed an issue where the option to unlock doors with a key was missing when the game language was set to Italian

World

 Fixed a misplaced invisible collision in Fort Narith
 Fixed an incorrect collision of a clothline in Tiget Bay
 Fixed several minor incorrect collisions in the starter towns
 Fixed the position of several spawn points that were placed too close to COPs
 Fixed misplaced black trash containers around the world
 Fixed a spot in the FOB where players could get stuck between a wall and a lamp
 Fixed various spots in a warehouse at Tiger Bay where players might get stuck
 Fixed a spot near the Spielberk COP where players could get stuck
 Fixed a spot in Sunset Chalet where players could get stuck
 Fixed a spot behind a box in Tiger Bay near UNLRA Refugee Camp where players could get stuck
 Fixed a rare issue where the skybox light changed suddenly
 Fixed the lounger seats on top of the main FOB building, which reacted to the wind
 Adjusted the collisions of stones on a road, which caused rough movement 
 Fixed a tree that was clipping with the flag in the Atlas COP, making it hard to distinguish which faction held the COP
 Fixed an issue where the COP flag color was only visible to enemy faction players within 100 meters of it
 Fixed impenetrable glass on the Fort Narith HQ building
 Adjusted the November 1, Julia 2, and Delta 1 LZs to provide more cover
 Fixed indoor flags incorrectly reacting to wind
 Fixed missing glass on a van's rear lights
 Fixed stretched textures on static dead bodies near the Sawmill
 Fixed an impenetrable cloth hanging at an employee’s house in Midnight Sapphire
 Fixed an issue where gazeebo lamps in the FOB were not destroyed completely when shot
 Fixed missing reflections on the water surface when wading through a lake
 Fixed the campfire visual effect

Health system & health screen

 Fixed an issue where dragging other players and kicking doors didn't drain stamina
 Fixed an issue that caused energy and hydration to be drained in captured COPs
 Fixed an issue where a fatal wound was displayed incorrectly if a player first went into a coma and then was killed
 Fixed an issue where wounds on body parts not protected with armor were displaying as stopped by armor

Animations

 Fixed unintended bolt movement during load animations of Type 51 and Glock
 Fixed a finger clipping through the weapon during the MP7 weapon check animation when the magazine is not attached
 Fixed an unnatural bend of the left index finger during the Beretta animations
 Fixed an unnatural shake during the Mossberg 590 during the empty reload animation in prone
 Fixed an issue where performing an animation didn't interrupt the COP capture progression bar
 Fixed an issue where pressing the right mouse button while sprinting could blur the screen and slow down the movement
 Fixed a visual desync between clients where one of the players is injured

Tasks & Strike missions

 Fixed the container location in the Muddy Buddy task
 Fixed an issue where the squad strike mission Weapon Redistribution couldn't be finished
 Changed the location of the task item required for the task King of the Crossroads so that it doesn't require a key
 Fixed an issue where squad striker missions failed automatically if a squad member was dead when the squad leader accepted the mission
 Fixed an incorrect task notification after reconnecting to the server
 Fixed task notification for auto-accepted tasks that appeared every time players connected to a server

Custom servers

 Fixed an issue where the invite code to a customer server got overwritten when switching tabs in the settings menu
 Fixed a connection error after shutting down a custom server
 Fixed the restart process for custom servers that resulted in a network error 
 Fixed the shutdown notification when custom servers are shut down

Other fixes

 Fixed an issue causing occasional rubberbanding when wading in water
 Fixed an issue that allowed items inside the plate carriers to be manipulated during repairs
 Fixed a VRAM leak during longer play sessions
 Removed selected caps from Banshee’s stock that were not intended to be for sale
 Adjusted the range for mortar strike announcements
 Update FSR to 3.1.3a
 Fixed an issue causing raindrops to appear black when falling on a car windshield
 Fixed an issue where players couldn't rejoin a full server if they were kicked for inactivity
 Fixed an issue that caused the Twitch rewards to be overwritten and displayed as already claimed if the player received other rewards before claiming them
 Fixed a rare issue where the pain sound is played repeatedly under specific circumstances
 The game window will no longer be minimized when pressing the F11 key
 Adjusted the operator voice-over volume level


If you encounter any further issues, please report them to our Customer Care. Your bug reports and feedback are invaluable in helping us improve Gray Zone Warfare: https://support.madfingergames.com/hc/en-us/requests/new

We’re committed to continually enhancing the Gray Zone Warfare experience and will keep working to improve the game. Development updates will be shared along the way, so stay tuned. Thank you for being part of this Early Access journey with us!

Every Move Matters,
MADFINGER Games Team

notes.title: Winds of War Out Now: The Fight is On
notes.content:
The island is shifting. The weather’s turned. Winds of War, the second major update for Gray Zone Warfare, is now live.

Built on community feedback, this update brings fresh content and meaningful improvements for both PvE and PvP players. Experience deeper immersion with a dynamic weather system, take on new challenges across expanded locations, enjoy more variety with new weapons and gear, and benefit from a smoother gameplay experience through key quality-of-life upgrades.

We’ve also added 11 new localizations, making the game more accessible to players worldwide.

Whether you're returning or dropping in for the first time, gear up and get ready.

Watch the Launch Trailer: 

[previewyoutube=Oy0xilcPibk;full][/previewyoutube]

What’s New in Winds of War
This update reshapes how you experience Gray Zone Warfare — with enhanced combat, evolving world, and long-requested quality-of-life improvements.

Key features:

 Dynamic & Realistic Weather System
 Combat Outposts - Strategic locations across Lamang that can be captured, occupied, and held for strategic advantage.
 Conflict Zones - Map markers that appear when PMCs engage enemy factions.
 4 New Weapons, 80+ Weapon Parts & 2 New Ammo Types
 Mortar Strikes
 60+ New Locations
 New Tasks, Reworked existing Tasks
 Strike Missions (Squad-Based Real-time Tasks)
 Revamped Task Flow
 New Vendor Vulture accessible at selected Combat Outposts
 Friend or Foe System - Audio and visual cues to distinguish faction members from enemies.
 Health System Enhancements
 Durability & Repairs Improvements
 Tracking Tags that help track gear
 Localization support for: German, French, Portuguese (Brazilian), Spanish, Italian, Polish, Czech, Turkish, Chinese (Simplified), Korean, Japanese


Read the complete CHANGELOG for all the details.

Learn more in the devlogs:

 Devlog #8 – Quality of Life Improvements
 Devlog #9 – Weapons & Gear
 Devlog #10 – World & Weather

Edition Upgrades
With Winds of War, all GZW editions have been enhanced. Each now includes better gear, weapons, and resources—ideal for PMCs looking for a stronger start and those supporting the game's continued development.

Check out the full breakdown in our latest article.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44732938/e71b3cefe957754b4575ef2300db0ac513eecf67.jpg

A Fresh Start for Everyone
This update includes a full progress wipe, giving all players a clean slate. It ensures a fair start and lets everyone dive into the redesigned systems, tasks, and economy on equal footing.

Wipes are essential to Early Access — they help us deliver major changes, rebalance the experience, and build the game together with the community. Thank you for your patience and support.

Updates Driven by You
Winds of War is built on your feedback — and we’re not stopping here. From combat balance to new features, the community continues to shape the future of Gray Zone Warfare. 

To name a few, we’ve added the ability to manage tasks directly in the field, cutting down on helicopter travel and wait times. We’ve introduced shared progression for elimination tasks within squads, or implemented tracking tags to make it easier to recover lost gear. Your input continues to drive meaningful improvements — keep it coming.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44732938/dc6fb1b4333ccbda37292162d2b9a9b34c5a2f43.jpg

Stay Tuned
This update is just the beginning. We plan on more features, content, and gameplay enhancements. Check out the official Roadmap to see what’s next.

Join the conversation on Discord, share your feedback, and help shape the path forward. Expect regular patches, hotfixes, and ongoing improvements.

The storm has arrived. Will you rise with it?

Every Move Matters,
MADFINGER Games Team

notes.title: Upgraded Editions for Gray Zone Warfare: Winds of War
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,

With the launch of Winds of War, the second major update for Gray Zone Warfare, we're enhancing the game editions to elevate your experience.

Step onto the unforgiving island of Lamang with editions crafted for elite PMCs, each loaded with essential gear, tools, and resources to ensure a smoother start in this relentless open world.

These editions go beyond in-game perks. They're a chance to support the development of Gray Zone Warfare while unlocking exclusive in-game rewards.

Which Edition Suits You? 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44732938/e71b3cefe957754b4575ef2300db0ac513eecf67.jpg

Standard Edition ($39.99 / 39.99€)   
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44732938/eaf36bc98694059ad2d9bb7794c9270e5d653b7c.jpg
Begin your journey and gear up for action with bonus equipment, a basic locker, and a lockbox.

Notes: 

 All items included in the editions can be obtained in-game without purchasing them. The editions simply offer a more convenient starting point while supporting the game’s development, which is still in its early stages.
 Additionally, if you’ve purchased one of the higher editions, the upgrade will be automatically applied to your account. There’s no need to repurchase the editions.

Editions Upgradability  

Our editions are designed to be upgradable, allowing you to transition to a higher tier seamlessly by paying only the difference in price. 

Start with the Standard Edition

 Begin your journey with the Standard Edition of Gray Zone Warfare.

Upgrade or Bundle Options

 Upgrade to the Tactical, Elite, or Supporter Edition at any time.
 To unlock the Supporter Edition, you must first own both the Tactical and Elite Editions.
 You can purchase the Supporter Bundle, which includes all DLCs. If you already own the Tactical and Elite Editions, you’ll only need to pay the difference to complete the bundle.

Receive Your Equipment

 After upgrading or purchasing a bundle, you’ll receive a message in-game to collect your edition equipment.

Important: As per Steam’s terms, all DLC purchases are non-refundable. This policy prevents potential fraud, consumable misuse, and disruptions to the in-game economy. 

Brace for Changing Skies

notes.title: Update 0.3 – Winds of War Changelog
notes.content:
Hello, GZW Community, 

Winds of War, the second major update for Gray Zone Warfare, will be released today. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44732938/4f49a711f058e16deedc1110ffd080356c20bc95.jpg

Built on community feedback, this update brings fresh content and meaningful improvements for both PvE and PvP players. Experience deeper immersion with a dynamic weather system, take on new challenges across expanded locations, enjoy more variety with new weapons and gear, and benefit from a smoother gameplay experience through key quality-of-life upgrades.

We've been closely monitoring reactions to the Winds of War Early Preview and made adjustments based on your input to improve the final release build. Nevertheless, expect patches, hotfixes, and ongoing improvements as we continue to refine the game together.

Find the  complete CHANGELOG below.

We’re dedicated to making Gray Zone Warfare the best it can be, and your feedback is vital in shaping its future. Share your experiences, thoughts, or any issues you encounter. Please report issues directly to Customer Care—we’re here to help. To engage with the dev team and community, you can also connect with us on Discord. 

If you missed it, we’ve also enhanced the Gray Zone Warfare editions, unlocking essential gear and tools for a smoother start in the relentless open world while giving you a chance to support the game’s development. For more details, check out this article.

The storm has arrived. Will you rise with it?

Every Move Matters, 

MADFINGER Games Team

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44732938/98359d6a47f6171e29034dcf50b3fdcaac04367a.jpg
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
IMPORTANT NOTE FOR NVIDIA USERS: We are currently experiencing a crash on startup on NVIDIA driver version 576.40 for most 50-series users. It is highly recommended that you stay on the previous versions or download a known stable driver version 576.28. We are working with NVIDIA to resolve the crash in the upcoming driver release. We are sorry for the inconvenience. 

New features
Realistic weather system

 Dynamic weather conditions, including rain, storms, fog, and wind, both during the day and at night
 Rice fields fill up with water during rainy weather
 The weather forecast is shown on the map and in the main menu and is based on real weather data
 Player characters react to the changing weather conditions - hydration and energy deplete faster in a hot and humid environment
 NPCs are also affected - wind and rain affect their hearing, while rain and fog affect their sight
Conflict Zones

 Get alerted about ongoing PVP conflicts on the map
 Conflict Zones are created on the map when PMCs from different factions engage in a fight 
 Conflict Zones stay on the map for a specific period of time, alerting players that a PVP fight is going on at this location
 Conflict Zones will disappear some time after the active firefight ends
Friend or Foe

 An improved system to detect friendly players in a fight and prevent accidental friendly fire
 Players of the same faction will have a visible armband on their arm to signal that they are friendly
 Enemy PMC players will have no armband visible, signifying they are an enemy
 An operator will warn players that a friendly player is in the area 
Tracking Tags

 Purchasable trackers to help you track your gear.
 We are adding the tracking tags to the game based on community feedback. Thank you for sharing your suggestions!  
 Tracking tags can be attached to equipment to track its position on the map - helpful in retrieving your body, for example
 If a player loots a piece of gear with a tracker attached, their position will be tracked as they move with the tagged equipment in their player inventory until the tracker duration expires
 Trackers cannot be removed from the tracked items, so be careful what you loot and watch your back!
Dragging bodies

 Drag your downed squadmate to a more favorable position before attending to their wounds in safety
Mortars

 Mortars make a comeback with a boom! Use them on the offense to support your attack run
 High-explosive mortar rounds can be found in the world or purchased from vendors, but they are very expensive
 Mortar strikes can be called to any location within a specific range (limited, so players cannot call mortar strikes at enemy FOBs)
 The time delay between the mortar strike being fired and the mortar shell landing is based on the distance
 Cannot be called to a location that is in proximity to friendly faction members
New vendor - Vulture

 This vendor is available at random at two of the major COPs to the faction that holds the outpost
 He sells items that have been lost by other players and despawned from the world, and some items that are not available at regular vendors 
New weapons

 SVD
 MP7
 Sig MCX
 Beretta M9A1
 Colt Combat Commander 
Experimental features
We introduce these features in their first iterations and want you to share your feedback - what you like about them, what you might not agree with, and what you would like to see improved. 
Combat Outposts - COPs

 New points of interest on the map that bring perks to the faction controlling them
 Guarded by neutral NPC guards until captured
 PVP implementation:

 Players can capture COPs for their faction
 Once captured by a faction, the COP is defended by the faction's NPC guards, who are hostile to other factions
 Can be recaptured by another faction
 Only one faction can hold it
 PVE implementation:

 Any faction can claim COPs by defeating the hostile NPC guards
 COPs can be shared between factions
Two levels:

 Minor COPs

 Captured COPs can be used as respawn points instead of base camps (base camp respawn is still available)
 Players can choose to respawn at the nearest COP or the base camp
 Players can access the locker and vendors in the COP
 Major COPs

 Same as minor, but with heavier defenses, harder to capture
 In addition, a special vendor (more info below) is available at two random major COPs on the map. The controlling faction will have access to his services. 
Squad Strike Missions

 Strike missions are a new addition that offers players a new way to progress through the game and creates a dynamic and unpredictable gameplay loop outside of the main campaign progression
 Strike missions appear randomly around the map and must be completed within a time limit
 They require players to be in a squad to accept and complete
Localization

 We are bringing the game to new audiences by localizing it to the following languages:

 German
 French
 Portuguese (Brazilian)
 Spanish
 Italian
 Polish
 Czech
 Turkish
 Chinese (Simplified)
 Korean
 Japanese
As always, if you encounter something not quite right (if a line is not appropriately localized to your language, or the text doesn't fit a button perfectly) let us know via the in-game feedback form or on our Discord.
Other gameplay changes
Repair system overhaul

 Removed durability loss on coma and death
 Durability is now affected solely by use and is amplified when bullets hit the weapon
 New repair mechanics give you a choice in how you want to approach maintaining your gear

 Slow repair is the more cost-effective way of preparing your gear, but the repaired item remains unusable during the process
 New repair kits provide an instant repair but come at a higher price 
Destructible light sources in the world

 Shoot out lights to gain an edge in night combat
Health system improvements

 Guts

 Guts are now an organ in the lower abdomen, and will cause a coma if destroyed
 Resolves the issue with AI surviving a high amount of shots to the lower abdomen due to a lack of vital organ placement in this area
 Updated health symptoms - sore arms, upset stomach, cramps, vomiting, tremors, and fainting
 More details about injuries on the health screen of the player and for enemies

 Information about the damage source (knife, bullet, barbed wire, etc.) is displayed
 If the source of an injury is a bullet, the ammo type, the armor penetration status, and the shot's direction are shown
 A new bleeding effect - blood drops on the ground when you're injured
 The fatal hit is highlighted
Tasks

 Tasks can be managed outside of the FOB

 We are improving the game flow by allowing you to accept and finish selected tasks anywhere on the map. This change will also help with managing the travel time and easing the helicopter system
 Task rewards can now also be claimed outside of the FOB 
Kill tasks have shared progression in a squad

 Tasks that require players to kill a specific number of enemies now have shared progression for all members of the squad
 New tasks and reworked tasks, new task types

 Updated tasks are marked to let players know they shouldn't approach them in the same way as before
Progression improvements

 Experience awarded for killing enemy PMCs (if the kill happens within a conflict zone)
 Economy rebalancing
 Changes to restocking
 Improvements to looting

 New lootbox locations
 New input methods such as keypads, padlocks, access cards, and safe locks
 Streamlined Starter Town progression

 Starter Town quests were updated to make the progression to other POIs faster
AI

 NPC readability improved

 New animations for NPCs - NPCs are checking their injuries, looking for blood when they sustain injuries
 New Limping animation for critically injured NPCs
 NPCs can be stunned 

 Headshot ricochet animation - When an NPC gets shot in the head but the bullet ricochets off its skull, players can identify what happened thanks to the new animation

notes.title: Everything You Need to Know About Twitch Drops
notes.content:
Hey, GZW Community, 

The Winds of War update is almost here, and you might be wondering why we are so excited to bring Twitch Drops to Gray Zone Warfare. Our first-ever campaign will run from May 22 to June 14, and we can’t do it without you. Let’s look at everything you need to know about the Drops and how the whole community will benefit from them. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44732938/a3221fafcfbce7c8c187e13952a8b7eb09e5428e.jpg

What are Twitch Drops?
Twitch Drops allow players to receive in-game rewards in exchange for watching creator streams that broadcast Gray Zone Warfare on Twitch. 

To earn rewards:

 Make sure you’re watching streamers who have Drops enabled in their streams. 
 You must link your Steam account with your Twitch account on the page we will share later this week. 

You will be able to check the progress of each campaign in your Twitch Account. You can find the drops when you click on your profile picture and go to the “Drops & Rewards” category. 

What is Support A Streamer?
Support A Streamer works essentially the same way, but instead of receiving rewards in exchange for watching creator streams, you get an in-game reward for purchasing different amounts of new recurring or gift subscriptions. This way, you can support your favorite creator and receive something valuable in Gray Zone Warfare.

Note: Prime Subscriptions do not count toward these rewards.

What Rewards Can You Expect?
Each Stage of our campaign consists of two types of rewards: Consumables and Apparel. 

The consumable items include repair kits, medical kits, weapons, gear, or even mortar strike shells. These items are present in the drops so they can help you ease into the new update more easily, try the new content faster, and generally have more fun. Once you earn the items, it is up to you when you use them; however, they can be lost, and will be wiped with the release of update 0.4, which will come roughly 6 months after Winds of War.

The second type of reward is apparel. If you follow all 3 stages of our Twitch Drops campaign, you can collect a whole new set of clothing, including gloves, trousers, boots, uniform, and glasses. This apparel is exclusive to Twitch Drops, and you won’t be able to get it any other way in the foreseeable future. Apparel won’t be wiped, and it will be carried over to future updates.

Timing Is Key
Our Twitch Drop campaign allows you to get quite a lot of items. It is split into 3 Stages, powered by Viktos & Gatorz - manufacturers of tactical gear used by soldiers and military enthusiasts. On top of that, we are collaborating on Veteran Drops with our friends from REGIMENT & Stack Up, organizations that help veterans across the United States.

In each stage, you’ll be able to participate in All-Access Drops, Exclusive Drops, and Support A Streamer (included in the 2 campaigns mentioned before) - each of those has different variant of the apparel, so it’s up to you if you pick the one you love the most or if you collect all of them, and put together three unique apparel sets. 

All campaigns start at 12:00 AM and end at 11:59 PM UTC.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44732938/0cc5116b112ee1ffc9c38991b69a0f4766e1d706.jpg

Here’s the schedule of each stage:

Stage 1: Powered by Viktos

 From May 22 to May 25
 Available campaigns:

 All-Access Drops - any creator can enable it
 Exclusive Drops - enabled for Field Agents & Elite Operators
 Support A Streamer (included in both campaigns)


Veteran Drops
REGIMENT: From May 26 to May 28 - any creator can enable it
Stack Up: From May 29 to May 31 - any creator can enable it
Stage 2: Powered by Viktos

 From June 1 to June 7
 Available campaigns:

 All-Access Drops - any creator can enable it
 Exclusive Drops - enabled for Field Agents & Elite Operators
 Support A Streamer (included in both campaigns)
Stage 3: Powered by Gatorz

 From June 8 to June 14
 Available campaigns:

 All-Access Drops - any creator can enable it
 Exclusive Drops - enabled for Elite Operators only
 Support A Streamer (included in both campaigns)

Creators With Access to Exclusive Twitch Drops
We are opening all the campaigns to any creators who want to enable them, except for Exclusive Drops. Those will be available to Field Agents & Elite Operators in Stage 1 and Stage 2. Stage 3 of Exclusive Drops will be available to Elite Operators only.

notes.title: Strengthening Anti-Cheat Protection in Gray Zone Warfare
notes.content:
Hey, GZW Community,

With the launch of the Winds of War update, we’re taking important steps to strengthen our anti-cheat efforts. Cheating undermines fair competition and damages the experience for everyone, and we take that seriously. That’s why we’re introducing new measures designed to make Gray Zone Warfare a more secure and fair environment for all players.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44732938/7c7045a4a63e2d48fd17f094ea7ec4df27c26b95.jpg
No Invasive Access
One of the key changes is the integration of Denuvo technology, which will help us increase the difficulty of tampering with the game. To be clear, we are not using the DRM component of Denuvo, nor are we implementing any new kernel-level anti-cheat measures. The version of Denuvo we’ve chosen operates at a different level, without invasive access to your system. This means you’ll benefit from improved protection without any downsides.

We understand that some players may have concerns. That’s why we made sure to thoroughly test this implementation before shipping it. Our internal performance benchmarks showed no detrimental impact on framerate or system responsiveness. GZW will run exactly as it did before, just with better protection.

Why We’re Keeping Some Details Under Wraps
We won’t be going into further detail about the specific anti-cheat measures we’ve implemented. Revealing those would only help cheat developers adapt, reducing the effectiveness of these systems before they’ve had a chance to do their job.

We know that transparency matters, and we’ll continue to communicate what we can. At the same time, protecting the integrity of the game means keeping some details confidential.

Reporting Cheaters
If you ever suspect a player of cheating, please report them to us using this link. Be sure to include conclusive video evidence with your report. Thank you for helping us keep the game fair.

As always, we appreciate your feedback and your continued support as we work to make Gray Zone Warfare the best it can be.

Every Move Matters,

notes.title: Winds of War Hands-On Showcase Recap: Live Gameplay and What’s Ahead
notes.content:
Hello, GZW Community,

We recently hosted the first-ever Winds of War Hands-On Showcase — an intense live event where content creators like Operator Drewski, Klean, NoiceGuy, Riloe, and Goodboi joined our dev team and members of the community to play and present the Winds of War update in real time.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44732938/9f24faa638ee4d5af73a47fcde186e0310034c77.jpg

Together, we dropped into Lamang to highlight new locations, features, and the evolving world of Gray Zone Warfare. This was the community’s first public look at the upcoming update in action.

That said, we want to clarify that the event didn’t fully represent a typical player experience. We were equipped with high-tier gear for the showcase and plenty of resources to demonstrate as much new content as possible. The session was also focused on three specific Combat Outposts. In normal gameplay, these scenarios will emerge more naturally.

Twitch Drops & Early Preview Incoming
At the start of the stream, we shared a few key announcements. First up: Twitch Drops are coming this May, giving players a chance to earn in-game rewards just by watching select streams. More information will be shared as the campaign approaches.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44732938/85d34fa8f5187d501992bfbd9dba2fedc092e3fd.jpg

We also announced an Early Preview window for select creators, running from May 17 to 21. Expect more gameplay footage and impressions during that period. This preview allows us to reach new audiences and gather valuable feedback on new features before release. We appreciate your patience and hope you enjoy the early content.

While we’re not ready to confirm a release date just yet, you can expect Winds of War to arrive shortly after the Early Preview. Final tweaks and adjustments are underway based on ongoing testing and feedback.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44732938/e587a395bb98bacc79507b0afd07e48faeabea98.jpg

Current Price Is the Lowest It Will Ever Be

Our CEO, Marek Rabas, joined the stream to announce an upcoming price increase for Gray Zone Warfare and its editions. As Marek explained, this decision reflects the realities of modern game development — rising server and operational costs, growing risk in the industry, and the expanding scope of the game. Also, more content means greater value, which will be reflected in the pricing. 

If you’ve been thinking about purchasing the game or upgrading your edition, now is the time — current pricing is the lowest it will ever be, aside from possible future discounts (which are not planned any time soon).

We’re also updating the contents of all game editions, with full details to be shared later this month.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44732938/3b02e48df4de967096fcf244b44c377d9977638b.jpg

Note: The final price will vary based on your region.

Good News for Lower-End PCs
As was stressed during the stream, we know not everyone plays on high-end hardware. That’s why we’ve reworked the Low graphics preset to improve performance more aggressively. While visual quality is reduced, foliage density remains unchanged to avoid any gameplay advantage. This change should make the game more accessible to players on lower-end systems.

Missed the Stream?

Watch the full VOD here: 

[previewyoutube=lBbVR2wFDlc;full][/previewyoutube]

Let us know what you think — your feedback plays a vital role in shaping the future of GZW.

Every Move Matters, 
MADFINGER Games Team

notes.title: Devlog #10: World & Weather in Winds of War
notes.content:
Hello GZW community,

With the Winds of War (0.3) update nearing its spring release, it’s time to dig into what you can look forward to. Our last devlogs covered the upcoming Quality of Life changes and new Weapons & Gear, and now we’re turning our attention to the evolving world of Lamang itself.

At the heart of Gray Zone Warfare is immersion— we strive to build a world that feels alive, dangerous, and reactive. The Day/Night cycle was only the beginning. With Update 0.3, we’re pushing that further with an all-new dynamic Weather System and dozens of new locations that deepen the island’s atmosphere and make exploration more meaningful.

[previewyoutube=odw_6YBo_t4;full][/previewyoutube]
EXPLORE THE EVOLVING WORLD OF LAMANG
With every major update, the world of Gray Zone Warfare will continue to grow richer and denser, and Winds of War is no exception. This update introduces over 60 new locations, each crafted with a specific purpose and designed to deepen Lamang’s atmosphere. Every site reinforces the game’s lore and reflects a world shaped by an unprecedented disaster.

You’ll encounter some standout new areas — from a hilltop restaurant and construction site to a radio station, sprawling poppy fields, and even a strip club. These locations add visual variety, environmental storytelling, and fresh tactical opportunities. Larger locations also serve as landmarks, making navigation through Lamang more intuitive.

We’ve also reworked some existing areas to offer a more refined experience. That familiar piece of cover you used to rely on? It might not be there anymore. Adapting to these subtle changes is part of surviving in a constantly shifting world. 

As you explore new and reworked locations, you might stumble upon hidden crates filled with valuable loot. This ties into our ongoing improvements to the loot system — we want exploration to feel truly rewarding. The gear you find in the field is now more likely to be something you’ll want to keep, use, and build your loadout around.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44732938/2c013bfcc7abcbac2496077320f5329275e0a6c6.gif

SEIZE AND CONTROL THE COMBAT OUTPOSTS
One of the biggest additions in Winds of War is the introduction of Combat Outposts (COPs). These strategic locations are spread across Lamang and can be captured, occupied, and held for strategic advantage. Lock one down, and your faction gets access to respawns, vendors, and resupply — all without returning to base.

There are 36 new outposts, split between minor and major types. Minor COPs are lightly defended and quicker to secure, while major ones offer tougher resistance. Holding a major outpost in PvEvP (Warfare) means stronger defensive positions and better area control.

In PvE (Joint Operations) mode, you’ll be able to capture COPs too, but without faction rivalry. That means all factions can take and use the same outpost simultaneously, making them shared safe zones.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44732938/cf13f354e05bba9fb1ec4bceebd2d72bd54eba57.jpg
TRACK DOWN VULTURE, THE NEW MYSTERIOUS VENDOR 
Major Combat Outposts come with a twist: two grant access to an elusive black market dealer known only as Vulture. Secure one of these specific COPs and you’ll unlock his stash of contraband. The selected COPs are the same across all servers, but rotate periodically, so keep an eye out.

Vulture is no hero. He was deep in the black market scene well before the evacuation of Lamang, and the chaos that followed gave his underground empire room to thrive. Now, his network combs the island for valuable gear and sells it to whoever pays the most.

In other words, Vulture offers weapons and equipment lost by other PMCs in challenging missions. If someone dropped it, and you’ve got the cash, it might be yours next.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44732938/8d964b96c8d5d5f40b290ca7e5bd19efa7767d5e.gif

EXPERIENCE THE AUTHENTIC WEATHER SYSTEM
When building the world of Gray Zone Warfare, our goal has always been to introduce real-life elements that impact how each playthrough unfolds. The day and night cycle was just the first step — a simple mission can become a tense scramble for survival once darkness falls and you’re caught unprepared.

With the Winds of War update, we’re taking that approach further with a brand-new dynamic weather system. This update adds eleven distinct weather presets — from clear skies and light overcast to dense mist and violent lightning storms. In its first iteration, weather will apply globally across the entire island. But we’re already planning for local weather in future updates, where it might be sunny in Ban Pa and storming in Fort Narith.

Each weather type dynamically interacts with variables like wind speed and direction, temperature, and humidity. Cloud coverage changes constantly, affecting ambient light and shadows. No two sunrises or sunsets will look the same, creating a world that feels alive and constantly shifting.

To ground the weather system in authenticity, we teamed up with meteorological experts at Meteosource to gather real-world data from Southeast Asia. Using this foundation, we built over 80 unique weather schedules that reflect genuine regional patterns, each lasting three in-game days and transitioning gradually to mirror the natural rhythm of real-world weather.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44732938/dfca5fd19a7cd423e33912df28e55b4f4f426b97.jpg

ENGAGE WITH THE ELEMENTS
Rain plays a significant role, and we’ve gone to great lengths to replicate how it behaves in real life: forming puddles with ripples, flowing down rooftops and terrain, muddying rivers, and flooding rice fields. 

And it isn’t just about the visuals — the whole weather system has direct gameplay implications. Your clothing responds to wetness, scopes can fog up, and raindrops can hit your field of view — unless you’re wearing gear to shield against it. Helmets, caps, and glasses all factor into visibility, and with the right combo, can reduce or eliminate visual interference entirely.

Weather brings new challenges to the battlefield. High temperatures and humidity will drain your hydration faster. Flooded rice fields slow your movement and wear down your stamina. Lightning strikes can silhouette you in the open, making shadow cover more critical.

And this is just the beginning. In future updates, we plan to expand the weather system with seasonal schedules, dynamic events like overflowing rivers that block paths or typhoons that ground aerial transport. Eventually, weather will also influence ballistics, affecting every shot you take.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44732938/2b9b4dcbb7dd74c522a827ed378d3b4d1e2197d4.gif
HEAR THE WORLD COME TO LIFE
An immersive world isn’t just about what you see — it’s also about what you hear. We’ve reworked the game’s ambient audio to be more dynamic and reactive, reflecting your environment and your situation. Rain, wind, and even cloud cover now influence the in-game sounds — sometimes helping you detect threats, other times masking them entirely. 

We’ve added new effects like splashing footsteps in flooded terrain or the distant rumble of thunder erupting into sudden, deafening cracks. With these changes, the island doesn’t just look more alive—it sounds more alive, too.

Fauna audio has also been expanded and refined. Wildlife is more varied and now responds to weather, going completely silent or growing louder in different conditions. 

[previewyoutube=vSO3fskob-E;full][/previewyoutube]
SHARE YOUR THOUGHTS
We hope you’re just as excited as we are about the new locations, dynamic weather, and everything else arriving with Winds of War. These changes all serve one purpose: to create a more immersive, reactive world where your decisions carry weight and no two encounters feel the same. As always, we want to hear from you. Your feedback is instrumental in shaping the future of Gray Zone Warfare. 
 
Plus, we want to thank you, the community, for your continued support, valuable feedback, and for helping us test the experimental version of Update 0.3. Your input is helping shape the future of Gray Zone Warfare, the first open-world extraction shooter on the market. 

Keep an eye on our socials for more updates, dev streams, and behind-the-scenes looks as we get closer to launch.

Every Move Matters, 
MADFINGER Games Team
